sites.name: Palace Embankment and Winter Canal
sites.basis: The retained standard elevation tiles give 17.534 m and 17.548 m at the Winter Palace south-plaza control. The 17.50 m ground leaves a small clearance below the 17.55 m roadway and removes elevated urban surface returns at the canal mouth. Bounds follow the embankment and adjoining approaches.

sites.name: Winter Palace and the Hermitage museum courts
sites.basis: The 17.50 m museum ground follows the retained south plaza sample and the mapped site from the Winter Canal to the west end of the Winter Palace. Bounds cover the five mapped main museum buildings and their immediate plazas. The shoulder transitions to the surrounding terrain.

sites.name: Saint Isaac’s Cathedral approaches
sites.basis: The mapped cathedral porticos share a single plinth level. The retained standard terrain is near 18.25 m on both unobstructed side approaches and gives elevated returns near the southwest portico. The grade follows the cathedral axes across the forecourts and blends gradually at the surrounding streets.

sites.name: Kokushkin Bridge approaches
sites.basis: The local grade places the adjoining road surface at the 20.504 m deck. The neighboring lanes and quays share this grade and a smooth shoulder restores the surrounding elevation field. The southeast bank samples include elevated surface returns.

sites.name: Catherine Palace court and garden frontage
sites.basis: The retained terrain gives 83.28 m and 83.54 m at the two corners of the main entrance apron, with elevated surface returns near the façades. The 83.42 m visualization grade exposes ground-floor windows and blends into the existing park and forecourt.

sites.name: Pergamon Museum wings and courtyard
sites.basis: The retained Mapzen Terrarium grid measures 36.63 m at the uncovered courtyard control, then slopes down across the mapped stone wing ends toward the Kupfergraben. The bounded visualization grade carries the courtyard level under the museum footprint and ties back into the existing terrain near the mapped canal bank.

sites.name: Hochberg mausoleum clearing
sites.basis: The restored exterior photographs show a clear stone base and curved entry stair on a small flat clearing. A 430.92 m visualization grade follows the retained approach elevations and exposes the base at the exact mapped footprint. A thirteen-metre shoulder ties this grade to the surrounding hill and preserves the mapped paths.

sites.name: Taipei Main Station forecourts
sites.basis: The photographed approaches have ordinary curb and step heights. Standard Terrarium gives 5.704 m and 5.923 m at the west and northwest outdoor controls, with an elevated 27.725 m return on the south plaza. The bounded 5.80 m visualization grade covers the headhouse and its immediate street approaches and blends back to the host field.

sites.name: Yaroslavsky passenger terminal and forecourt
sites.basis: The mapped terminal annexes and photographed forecourt meet the passenger floor at a low threshold. Correct coarse surface returns inside the occupied site and the adjoining strip of sidewalk.

sites.name: Yaroslavsky boarding tracks and main platform group
sites.basis: The main mapped terminal track and platform group shares a deck near the headhouse. Keep enough vertical separation for paths and rails and blend back beyond the station edge.

sites.name: Yaroslavsky outer passenger platform
sites.basis: Narrow extension to keep the longest passenger platform and its immediate rail approaches tied to the native surface.

sites.name: Osun Grove footbridge riverbanks
sites.basis: Lower the coarse standard heightfield along the mapped straight reach at the suspension footbridge. Retain the original sampled terrain beyond the grading shoulders and the standard River Osun line and surface.

sites.name: Çırağan Palace historic waterfront court
sites.basis: Retained PMTiles establish the occupied palace, the grass plots, the quay and the signed Bosphorus frontage. Exterior photographs establish a low court and a low rusticated basement, with two stair flights at the southwestern entrance. A low granite-facing strip follows the mapped seawall on the historic frontage. A 3.5 m local visualization grade ties the model to the court. The aligned offshore grade removes residual positive elevation over the sea near the mapped quay.

sites.name: Çırağan Palace mapped Bosphorus edge
sites.basis: The mapped Bosphorus edge follows local Z 48–50 m. Depress coarse surface returns on the marine side so the native sea plane covers them.

sites.name: El Chocón terrain reservoir shore
sites.basis: The retained standard raster has isolated sub-280 m void samples among its 315–388 m local slopes. Only these depressions are raised to the representative nearby ground stage.

sites.name: El Chocón terrain downstream works
sites.basis: The retained standard raster has isolated sub-280 m void samples among its 315–388 m local slopes. Only these depressions are raised to the representative nearby ground stage.

sites.name: El Chocón terrain east shore

sites.name: El Chocón powerhouse access
sites.basis: The two mapped service approaches along the powerhouse meet a shared 319.03 m concrete apron. Lower the dry-access grade to the modeled water-side platform.

sites.name: Sofa Mosque forecourt
sites.basis: The retained standard field samples 35.14 m beside the photographed entrance. The bounded forecourt meets the two entrance treads and blends into the garden slope.

sites.name: Has Oda Koğuşu arcade landing
sites.basis: The retained standard field samples 45.98 m at the center of the photographed arcade. The bounded courtyard shoulder meets the shallow stone landing and preserves the adjoining court.

sites.name: Dolmabahçe Palace waterfront court
sites.basis: The ordinary exterior pictures show a shallow palace plinth and court above the mapped Bosphorus edge. The 3.18 m court follows the principal waterfront footprint and connects both entrances.

sites.name: Dolmabahçe Palace inland harem court
sites.basis: The retained elevation field rises across the inland wing and buries the recessed entry at a coastal datum. The 3.18 m court extends only along the mapped harem return, with a shoulder toward the landward streets.

sites.name: Dolmabahçe Palace marine edge
sites.basis: The native sea begins along the mapped quay at local Z 93–95 m. Lower the residual positive elevations seaward of the quay while preserving the mapped water and other basemap inputs.

sites.name: Grand Kremlin Palace west court and return
sites.basis: The photographed west approach meets the base of the arcaded range on a terrace. The lower west height returns do not represent that terrace beside the palace.

sites.name: Grand Kremlin Palace historic northwest return
sites.basis: The bounded northwest shoulder follows the connected angled return. The adjacent independent buildings and the slope beyond the local shoulder remain in the scene.

sites.name: Grand Kremlin Palace southern terrace
sites.basis: The 156.85 m grade follows the narrow mapped terrace above the retained river-facing slope, consistent with the photographed base of the south arcade.

sites.name: Grand Kremlin Palace east arcade court
sites.basis: The narrow strip exposes the lower arcade beside Cathedral Square. The native pavement continues around the facade and blends toward the square.

sites.name: Manantali Dam northern service turn
sites.basis: A short shoulder keeps the mapped approach road at the model’s crest height and blends into the retained northern hillside.

sites.name: Manantali Dam spillway outfall shoulder
sites.basis: The retained Bafing polygon meets the dry chute outlet here. A narrow bank grade follows the low downstream shoulder beside the final spillway bay.

sites.name: Manantali Dam southern service turn
sites.basis: The two tight bends on the mapped service lane meet the crest at a low abutment. The surface is fitted within the turn and transitions to the retained hillside.

sites.name: Manantali Dam west shoulder

sites.name: Gariep Dam western crest approach
sites.basis: The level crest meets the retained tertiary road near the first western bend. The standard terrain rises to the representative 1271 m roadway nearby.

sites.name: Gariep Dam eastern crest approach

sites.name: Gariep Dam paired outlets shore
sites.basis: The photographed paired openings sit above a low stone shore. Expose their lower wall and fit the bank down to the mapped Orange River.

sites.name: Gariep Dam powerhouse apron bank
sites.basis: The lower powerhouse portals open over the retained riverbank. A bounded bank strip fits the modeled apron while the upper access stays independent.

sites.name: Gariep Dam east arch toe and rock apron

sites.name: Gariep Dam north arm low raster samples

sites.name: Gariep Dam reservoir and upper wing raster lows
sites.basis: The sampled terrain contains spurious lows near the dam and on its uphill side. Leave normal samples and shelves in place.

sites.name: Sennar Dam Gezira intake channel
